target.purpose: Stop training progression after sustained non-finite numerical failure instead of allowing NaN storms to propagate through subsequent steps.
target.central_bottleneck: Training can continue consuming compute and corrupting state when non-finite values are observed but do not change execution authority.
success: The breaker trips after the configured consecutive non-finite threshold.
The latched OPEN state blocks protected training steps while the breaker is active.
Recovery requires an explicit valid reset rather than an implicit return to normal operation.

invariants: sustained non-finite input trips the breaker
OPEN breaker state blocks protected steps
finite observations reset the consecutive-failure counter before trip
reset is explicit and rejects malformed reset authority

donor_plan.basis: The current repository owns the implemented NaN circuit-breaker mechanism; no donor implementation is required to define or operate it.
donor_plan.future_extraction: Reusable non-finite circuit-breaker semantics may be extracted only with lineage, functional/proof equivalence, and preservation of this repository's identity.

nonclaims: reference training-safety engineering system, not a production NVIDIA training controller
no production deployment without independent receipt
reconciliation_reason: Removed unresolved merge-conflict markers and reconciled the stronger target contract with the implemented latched-open breaker semantics.
